name: Composer 669
description: Tran's eight-channel music tracker, where the 669 format began
author: Tran

ready.stdout: Press any key to go on

start.note: DosKit goes past its opening reminder to the editor. It has no song of its own: bring in a .669 with the Files button, then F11 loads it and F5 plays it.

hint: Press any key to go on to the editor; then F11 lists the .669 songs brought in with the Files button, Enter loads one and F5 plays it.
